theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneExceptional_measurableSet
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) {X : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))), IsCompact A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ (α : X → Rn (n + ℓ)) (F₁ F₂ : X → Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn (n + ℓ)), Continuous α → Continuous (fun q : X × Rn (n + ℓ) ↦ F₁ q.1 q.2) → Continuous (fun q : X × Rn (n + ℓ) ↦ F₂ q.1 q.2) → MeasurableSet {ξ : X | α ξ ∈ A ∧ ¬ ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖F₁ ξ (x - α ξ)‖ < s * ‖F₂ ξ (x - α ξ)‖} ∩ Metric.ball (α ξ) r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∨ (∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖F₁ ξ (x - α ξ)‖ < s * ‖F₂ ξ (x - α ξ)‖} ∩ Metric.ball (α ξ) r))) ∨ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ (α ξ) ∧ dist b (α ξ) < δ ∧ F₁ ξ (b - α ξ) = 0)}
